title: Hot Honey Grilled Sausage & Peppers
seoTitle: Hot Honey Grilled Sausage & Peppers | Firehall BBQ
shortDescription: Weeknight-fast BBQ energy with zero stress
subtitle: Charred links, sweet heat, and toasted buns for ten
description: Sausage links grill alongside peppers and onions, then get tossed with hot honey and vinegar so they taste like BBQ without needing a smoker.

steps.title: Heat grill
steps.instruction: Heat grill to medium-high. Oil grates. Toss peppers/onions with oil, salt, pepper.

steps.title: Grill sausage
steps.instruction: Grill links 12–15 minutes, turning, until browned and 160°F internal. Move to indirect if flare-ups.

steps.title: Char the veg
steps.instruction: Grill peppers/onions in a basket or on a plancha until softened and charred, 8–10 minutes.

steps.title: Hot honey glaze
steps.instruction: Whisk honey, hot sauce, and vinegar. Toss sausage and veg in a tray with the glaze.

steps.title: Tonight’s board
steps.instruction: Toast rolls. Pile sausage + peppers. Put extra hot honey on the table.

steps.title: Leftovers
steps.instruction: Slice and fold into pasta, or scramble with eggs. Reheat covered so links don’t split.

proTips: Use a thermometer—sausage looks done before it’s safe.
Vinegar keeps the honey from tasting flat.
Toast buns last to keep them from steaming.
tonightSpread: Sausage tray, peppers/onions tray, buns, hot honey bottle.
leftovers: Sausage pepper subs on garlic bread.
whyCrewsLikeIt: It’s fast, it’s loud, and it stays good even if you have to hold it. Perfect for a one-cook night.
mealPrepNotes: Grill everything, then hold in a covered pan. Toast buns last minute so they don’t steam.
heroImageAlt: Hot Honey Grilled Sausage & Peppers — crew-sized BBQ spread with visible smoke and bark

adaptable.label: Gluten-Free Adaptable
adaptable.note: Use a certified gluten-free bun/bread and toast on a separate, clean surface.

adaptable.label: Pork-Free Adaptable
adaptable.note: Swap in chicken or turkey sausage.
